title: Split CLI play command integration hub
description:
Refactor packages/cli/src/play.ts so it no longer owns campaign resolution, character prompting, session launch/resume, turn loop, graceful close, checkpoint wiring, arc rollup, and terminal IO in one large file.

Keep behavior stable while separating CLI presentation from lifecycle orchestration.
acceptance_criteria:
- play.ts is reduced to command wiring/composition.
- Character prompting is isolated.
- Turn loop is isolated.
- Graceful close/session-close CLI behavior is isolated.
- Campaign/session resolution is isolated or delegated.
- Existing CLI tests pass.
close_reason: Refactored into playTypes.ts, playCharacter.ts, playSession.ts, playClose.ts, playTurnLoop.ts. PR #71 open for review.
